notes_for_editor: Two pages probably describe one site: firelookout.com's Triangle Hill (57' crow's nest, 1930s, ruins) and Forest Lookouts' Triangle Hill Tree (57-ft tree lookout, 2007 entry, legal location 17S-10E-16). Both give 57 feet, but neither says they are the same structure, so the story says 'appears' and a human should confirm. The legal location was not checked against the record's coordinates (44.09928, -121.54082). No build year, staffing, fire history or Former Fire Lookout Sites registration was found; the index row has no register number. The 1930s date is a decade only, so no event year was used for it. Record kind 'platform' fits a crow's nest or tree; no correction proposed. Confidence is low.
